comment: Hand-built emit IR mirroring examples/sovcommon/roles, examples/sovcommon/ui and examples/teamboard/taxonomy.canon; the lookup cells are computed by the test (fixture_test.go) from the bodies of taxonomy.canon.

packages.name: sovcommon.roles
packages.doc: Account roles of the website and every internal tool.

enums.name: Role
enums.doc:
The website.website_account.role literals. Declaration order IS the rank:
`gm_junior < maintainer` is true, and nothing else may hard-code a number.

Today this ladder is written three times (roles.go, roles.ts and the SQL CHECK
constraint) and kept in sync by comments. Here it is written once, and Go and TS
are generated from it.

packages.name: sovcommon.ui
packages.doc: UI vocabularies shared by every web front end: colour tones and icon names.

enums.name: Tone
enums.doc:
A semantic or qualitative colour slot. Each one resolves to a --color-* token that
tokens.css defines for dark and light, with its -soft background. No colour value
lives in config.

Semantic tones are reserved for meaning (status, severity, flags, intent).
Qualitative series slots tell families apart, always together with icon + label.

enums.name: Icon
enums.doc:
Icons sovcommon exports (icons.ts). An icon that is not listed here is a type
error wherever it is used, so `make check` no longer has to scrape TypeScript.

packages.name: teamboard
packages.doc:
Taxonomy of the team board (internal.ragyra.com).

Rewrite of sovcommon/teamboard/taxonomy.json v7. The ~30 load-time checks in
load.go and refs.go become three things here:
  - types: unknown refs, roles, tones, icons, setBy, fields, duplicate or
    badly formed ids, required fields. There is no code for any of them.
  - stable tables: "never renamed, never reused, retire instead of delete".
  - the eight `check`s at the bottom: the rules that are truly about this data.

The reporter makes ONE classification: WHERE did you see it (area). Everything
finer is said in the text; routing to a technical area is the triager's move.

enums.name: Actor
enums.doc: Who may set a flag or make a transition.

enums.name: PostField
enums.doc: Inputs a status transition may collect.

records.name: Intent
records.doc: What kind of post this is; `minRole` gates who may post it.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: Colour of the intent's badge.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Icon of the intent's badge.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What the reporter picks, as a sentence.

fields.name: minRole
fields.doc: The lowest role that may post with this intent.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: Colour of the flag's badge.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Icon of the flag's badge.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What the reporter ticks, as a sentence.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc: Shown under the label.

fields.name: setBy
fields.doc: Who may set the flag.

fields.name: viewMinRole
fields.doc: Who may see that the flag was set; `none` means whoever can see the post.

records.name: Status
records.doc: One point of the post lifecycle.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: Colour of the status badge.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Name of the status.

fields.name: terminal
fields.doc: A terminal status closes the post. It can still be reopened through `next`.

fields.name: next
fields.doc: The closed set of statuses a post may move to from here.

fields.name: requires
fields.doc: Inputs a transition INTO this status must collect.

fields.name: optional
fields.doc: Inputs a transition INTO this status may collect.

fields.name: by
fields.doc: Who, besides a triager, may make the transition into this status.

records.name: Severity
records.doc: Set by a triager only. The reporter's single signal is the `blocking` flag.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: Colour of the severity badge.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Name of the severity.

fields.name: default
fields.doc: The severity a triaged post gets unless the triager picks another.

records.name: AreaGroup
records.doc: A header the area picker and the move-to-area menu group areas under.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Header text.

records.name: Area
records.doc: Where the reporter stood, never which component is at fault.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: The header the area is listed under.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: Family: series_1 game, series_2 web, series_3 tooling, series_4 internal.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Icon next to the area's name.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Name of the area.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc: Shown under the label.

fields.name: minRole
fields.doc: Gates posting AND viewing.

fields.name: routesTo
fields.doc: Technical areas a triager typically moves a post into. Orders the move menu only.

records.name: Column
records.doc: One fixed column of the deck: a named set of statuses.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Column header.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Icon in the column header.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc: The statuses whose posts the column shows.

fields.name: assigneeFilter
fields.doc: Adds a multi-select of eligible members inside the column.

fields.name: hideable
fields.doc: Lets a viewer collapse the column to the rail (capped by `deck.maxHidden`).

records.name: Deck
records.doc: The deck: fixed columns, in order. Nobody adds, removes or edits a column.

fields.name: layouts
fields.doc: The only arrangements: all in one row, or a 2x2 grid.

fields.name: maxHidden
fields.doc: How many columns may be collapsed at once, so the deck never goes fully empty.

records.name: AreaSection
records.doc: One group header with the areas shown under it.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: The header.

fields.name: areas
fields.doc: The areas under it, in declaration order.

fields.label: Only the dev team should see

values.name: assigneeMinRole
values.doc:
A post is owned by exactly one person, and never by a GM. Take = assign to yourself;
a triager may assign to any eligible member.

values.name: triageMinRole
values.doc: The lowest role that may triage.

values.name: columns
values.doc: The deck's columns, left to right.

values.name: severities
values.doc: How bad a triaged post is.

values.name: areaGroups
values.doc: The headers of the area picker.

fields.label: Balance
fields.hint: Nothing is broken, the numbers feel wrong.

fields.label: Website
fields.hint: The site, accounts, rankings, donations and payments.

fields.label: Team board
fields.hint: This board itself: something broken or missing here.

values.name: initialStatus
values.doc:
A new post starts here: the single status of the first column. The deck has at least
two columns (`maxHidden` >= 1 is below their count), so `first()!` cannot fail.

values.name: defaultSeverity
values.doc:
The severity a triaged post gets unless the triager picks another. Exactly one
exists: see the `default` check below.

fns.name: columnOf
fns.doc:
sovcommon's ColumnOf. `none` for a status no active column claims (only a retired
status can be in that case), like the `(Column, bool)` it replaces.

fns.name: areasVisibleTo
fns.doc: sovcommon's AreasVisibleTo: minRole gates viewing and posting.

fns.name: groupedAreasVisibleTo
fns.doc: sovcommon's GroupedAreasVisibleTo: headers only for groups with a visible area.
